title: The Times-Eleven Trick
summary: Try small cases, spot the pattern, then use it.

steps.title: The puzzle
sentences: Multiply 23 by 11 in your head, without writing anything.
There is a quick pattern. Can you spot it?
points: Multiply 23 by 11 in your head, without writing anything.

steps.title: How to think about it
sentences: Try a few by hand: 12 times 11 is 132, and 31 times 11 is 341.
Look at the middle digit of each answer and compare it to the two digits you started with.
points: Try a few by hand: 12 times 11 is 132, and 31 times 11 is 341.

steps.title: The method: Look for a pattern
sentences: For a two-digit number, write the first digit, then the sum of the two digits, then the last digit.
So 23 becomes 2, then 2 plus 3 equals 5, then 3, which gives 253.
If the sum is 10 or more, carry the 1 to the left.
points: For a two-digit number, write the first digit, then the sum of the two digits, then the last digit.

steps.title: The answer
sentences: 54 times 11: 5, then 5 plus 4 equals 9, then 4, which gives 594.
For 78 times 11: 7, then 15, then 8. Carry the 1 to get 858.
The trick works because times 11 means times 10 plus times 1, so each digit is added to its neighbour.

quiz.why: 4, then 4 plus 5 equals 9, then 5, which gives 495.
3, then 3 plus 6 equals 9, then 6, which gives 396.
